## Description

Eight-step systematic market sizing and validation method, distilled from the hydraulic-breaker region×segment×scenario engagement (2026-08) and applied to every new market sizing task. Covers axis definition, anchor triangulation, region×segment allocation, scenario bands, bottom-up vs top-down consistency checking, first-party (company filing) cross-validation, a limitations register, and formal registration into the assumption registry. Use when: "market sizing", "TAM/SAM/SOM", "market matrix", "region×segment demand estimate", "market cross-validation against filings", "scenario bands for market size".
